title: Preregistered gate -> structural trigger -> single confirmation combination, judged by expectancy (RR-aware), with costs
type: signal-quality + expectancy measurement; NO position sizing, NO stop-moving, NO capital; transaction cost applied as a fixed R deduction only
does_not: test VPFR or any new indicator
change primary target after seeing results

time_split.rule: holdout read ONCE, only after the selection commit is frozen

target.why_primary: From L0079 (train): RR=2 breakeven is 33.33% and measured decided-win% sits 32.6-34.2% for all variants => the 2:1 target is fairly priced, higher RR bought no edge. Per-holding-bar expectancy favours the short 1:1 target in every case on train (1:1/6bars up to 0.0046 R/bar vs 2:1/18bars up to 0.0014 R/bar). 2:1's only benefit is fewer undecided (5-6% vs 13-14%), a statistical not a profit benefit.
target.expectancy_formula: expectancy_R = win_rate*RR - (1-win_rate); win_rate = P/(P+N) over DECIDED cases (P=positive_before_negative, N=negative_before_positive); neither/ambiguous are undecided and excluded from expectancy (reported separately).

mandatory_contamination_disclosure: The target decision was taken AFTER L0079 holdout numbers had already been read. The supporting evidence in 'why_primary' is train-only and sufficient on its own, but disclosure is required. Compensation: L0080 selection uses purged k-fold WITHIN TRAIN only (k=5, purge=18 bars, embargo=18 bars); holdout is final confirmation only; the target choice is counted as one extra degree of freedom in the testing budget.
future_target_rule: Any future candidate target is first evaluated with NO signal on train only for: unconditional base rate vs breakeven, undecided%, effective sample after window overlap, expectancy per holding bar. A target whose unconditional base rate is far from breakeven is rejected (free directional drift would corrupt any measured edge).

gates.GATE_EMA200: close above EMA200 for long / below for short (level at bar i)
gates.GATE_ADX: ADXDI_20_22 active in the matching direction (pdi>ndi & adx>=22 long; ndi>pdi & adx>=22 short)

confirmations.CONF_OBV: OBV_SMA20 agrees in direction (obv>sma(obv,20) long / < short)
confirmations.CONF_MACD: MACD_8_21_5 line vs zero agrees (ema8-ema21>0 long / <0 short)

locked_candidates.rationale: All chosen names either survived OOS in L0077/L0079 (ADXDI_20_22, MACD_8_21_5, FVG_3BAR_BASE, OBV_SMA20, EMA200-context) or are the raw baseline required for comparison. RSI/Bollinger/MFI/Stochastic/Turtle are FORBIDDEN (already failed OOS).

n_tests_locked.multiplicity_correction: Benjamini-Hochberg q=0.10 on the PRIMARY target only
n_tests_locked.p_value_test: one-sided binomial (normal approx w/ continuity correction) H0: win_rate<=0.5 vs win_rate>0.5, on DECIDED cases (expectancy_R>0 <=> win_rate>0.5 at RR=1)
n_tests_locked.target_df: target selection counts as +1 df; BH reported at m=27 and, as sensitivity, m=28

eligibility_before_comparison.note: failing any => INSUFFICIENT, excluded from selection (guards against the MSS_L8 100%-on-3-cases trap in L0079)

costs.source: ASSUMED fixed round-trip cost in R units (0.05 and 0.10). No per-asset microstructure/fee data available; 0.10R is the conservative decision barrier. This is the first lane to include costs; the old 'no-cost' check is replaced by 'costs applied and disclosed'.

correct_comparison: Every combination is compared to the SAME trigger with GATE_NONE + CONF_NONE over the same period; difference recorded in pp and R. Never compared to 50% in isolation.

random_control.matched: signal count and per-symbol temporal pool

purged_kfold.constraint: at most ONE combination per structural trigger; max 3 selected

holdout_success_criteria: Wilson lower bound on win_rate > breakeven for the RR used (0.50 at RR=1)
positive direction in the majority of holdout years
prior_expected_verdict: Best known OOS win_rate is ADXDI_20_22 at 52.95% which is BELOW the 55% after-cost barrier => prior most-likely outcome is FAIL or MARGINAL. Report must NOT be written optimistically.
checks_11: no future leakage in any indicator/gate
BH applied+recorded and target df counted
selection train-only and freeze commit precedes holdout read
purged k-fold with purge&embargo=18 and no inter-fold leakage
fail_recommendation: If FAIL: stop stacking classic indicators and move to a different information class; do NOT try more settings.
